loopContract.bounded: A loop stops on terminal state, unchanged progress, failed lane, or --max-cycles.
loopContract.positiveEvidence: No loop may turn an empty provider result, missing row, or skipped step into absence.
loopContract.canonicalWrites: The runner never edits truth stores; existing scoped lanes may reproject their declared outputs.
loopContract.mergeBoundary: Every loop report is partial L0-L2 evidence; scripts/regen.py --check remains the L3 merge gate.

loops.title: Issue attachment to positive physical observation
loops.gateLevel: L0-L2 scoped lane; L3 merge gate
loops.retry: Replay the same Run-ID after a new attachment or reviewed specimen; stop after maxCycles when evidence is unchanged.
loops.progressMetric: specimen, physical-observation, photograph-hash, and attachment counts
stopReasons: all retained specimens have positive physical observations

loops.title: Evidence observation to application status
loops.gateLevel: L0-L2 scoped lane; L3 merge gate
loops.retry: Replay after positive evidence or owner adjudication; never retry an unchanged application store indefinitely.
stopReasons: new positive evidence or owner adjudication is required

loops.title: Retained discovery run to reconciliation boundary
loops.gateLevel: L0-L2 scoped lane; L3 merge gate
loops.retry: Replay a retained Run-ID; use --include-live only for an explicit provider refresh, then reconcile the new positive run.
loops.progressMetric: latest retained source/card run status plus explicit gap terminal states
stopReasons: provider boundary needs a new positive source

loops.title: News or promo lead to concrete source and graph claim
loops.gateLevel: L0-L2 scoped lane; L3 merge gate
loops.retry: Replay after a concrete official lead/source is recorded; News alone never retries into automatic card confirmation.
loops.progressMetric: source, news/promo lead, and positive graph-claim counts
stopReasons: a concrete source and positive claim are reconciled

loops.title: TCGdex candidate, review, acceptance, and projection
loops.gateLevel: L0-L2 scoped lane; L3 merge gate
loops.retry: Replay after an explicit candidate refresh or owner acceptance; no candidate means a bounded stop, not a polling loop.
loops.progressMetric: candidate presence, snapshot record count, and candidate diff counts
stopReasons: no candidate exists; explicit refresh is required

loops.title: Scoped contradiction to adjudicated absence
loops.gateLevel: L0-L2 scoped lane; L3 merge gate
loops.retry: Replay after scope expansion or owner adjudication; a missing provider row remains pending/disputed.
loops.progressMetric: evidence application counts and owner-adjudication count
stopReasons: owner decision settles the scoped contradiction

loops.title: Frozen Cardmarket baseline or positive listing evidence
loops.gateLevel: L0-L2 scoped lane; L3 merge gate
loops.retry: Replay after a positive seller listing/photo; the frozen historical baseline is never rewritten or expanded by retry.
loops.progressMetric: frozen baseline, listing specimen, positive listing, and catalogue-expansion counts
